# MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.2.3 (Google, Apache-2.0)

Selfi bosqichida tojni yuzga o'tkazish uchun yuzni aniqlash (FaceDetector).
Tashqi CDN'ga bog'liq bo'lmasligi uchun shu yerda saqlanadi.

- `vision_bundle.mjs` — `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.2.3` npm paketidan
- `wasm/vision_wasm_internal.js` — o'sha paketdan
- `wasm/vision_wasm_internal.wasm.gz` — o'sha paketdagi wasm, gzip bilan siqilgan
  (server uni `Content-Encoding: gzip` bilan beradi)
- `face.tflite` — `blaze_face_short_range` modeli (storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models)
